Macrons

Consonantal i

SearchHow we decideRulings

Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas · Nature & food

male adjective and noun

of the sex that does not bear young

also a male, male animal, masculine

classical

Varr. LL 9.56: appellātur mās columbus, fēmina columba
Liv. 22.1.13: gallīnam in marem

mās, maris

adjective and masculine noun, third declension

male; as a noun, a male

Examples

  • nunc contrā, propter domesticōs ūsūs quod internōvimus, appellātur mās columbus, fēmina columba

    now, on the other hand, since keeping them at home has taught us to tell them apart, the male is called <span lang="la">columbus</span> and the female <span lang="la">columba</span>Varr. LL 9.56

  • gallīnam in marem, gallum in fēminam sēsē vertisse

    that a hen had turned into a cock, and a cock into a henLiv. 22.1.13

  • duo et duo ingressa sunt ad Noë in arcam, masculus et fēmina

    two by two they went in to Noah into the ark, male and femaleVulg. Gen. 7.9

Other words

  • masculus, mascula, masculum — male; manly

    also used · classical · Liv. 31.12.6: masculus an fēmina (Lewis & Short); Vulg. Gen. 7.9: masculus et fēmina

    Not in Cicero or Caesar (Lewis & Short).

  • virīlis, virīle — of a man, male; manly

    also used · classical · Liv. 1.3.11 (Lewis & Short)

See also man, lady.

SourcesLewis & Short: mas · Lewis & Short: masculus · Lewis & Short: virilis
